'''Nayatel''' ({{langx|ur|نیاٹیل}}) is an [[Internet service provider|Internet Service Provider]] (ISP) with its headquarters located in [[Islamabad|Islamabad, Pakistan]]. It was founded in 2006 and is currently led by CEO Wahaj-us-Siraj.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Shah |first1=Syed Aamir Ali |last2=Jajja |first2=Muhammad Shakeel Sadiq |date=2021-01-10 |title=Nayatel: Quality in DNA |url=http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/0972820120982239 |journal=Asian Journal of Management Cases |language=en |pages=097282012098223 |doi=10.1177/0972820120982239 |issn=0972-8201|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

It provides telephone, fiber-based broadband internet and television services to residential and corporate customers in nine cities across Pakistan.

== History ==
Micronet Broaband (Pvt.) Limited (MBL) was Pakistan's first [[Digital subscriber line|DSL]] operator, launched in July 2002 by co-founders Wahaj-us-Siraj, Aqeel Khurshid and Saad Saleem.<ref>{{Cite web |date=6 March 2019 |title=Rating Report - Nayatel (Pvt.) Limited |url=https://www.pacra.com/summary_report/RR_1563_6992_06-Mar-19.pdf |access-date=29 August 2023 |website=The Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Limited}}</ref>

In 2006, Nayatel was created as a subsidiary of Micronet Broadband (Pvt.) Limited (MBL) as Pakistan's first [[Fiber to the x|Fiber-to-the-Home]] (FTTH) service provider.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Who We Are? |url=https://nayatel.com/who-we-are/ |access-date=2023-08-29 |website=Nayatel |language=en-US}}</ref>

Nayatel's services were exclusive to the [[twin cities]] of Islamabad and Rawalpindi, however, in 2016, they expanded to Faisalabad<ref>{{Cite web |date=1 November 2016 |title=Nayatel is Launching FTTH Broadband in Faisalabad in Two Weeks |url=https://propakistani.pk/2016/11/01/nayatel-launching-ftth-broadband-faisalabad-two-weeks/ |access-date=29 August 2023 |website=ProPakistani}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=TechJuice |date=2016-11-01 |title=Nayatel to launch fiber to home broadband in Faisalabad |url=https://www.techjuice.pk/nayatel-to-launch-fiber-to-home-broadband-in-faisalabad/ |access-date=2024-05-27 |website=TechJuice |language=en-US}}</ref> and in 2018, Peshawar was added to their coverage area.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Deployment of Optic Fiber Network in Peshawar by NayaTel |url=https://kpboit.gov.pk/deployment-of-optic-fiber-network-in-peshawar-by-nayatel/ |access-date=2023-08-29 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Products ==

=== Voice ===
Nayatel offers fixed-line [[Plain old telephone service|telephone services]] as an option to all subscribers.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Fixed Line Telephony: PHONE |url=https://nayatel.com/phone/ |access-date=2023-08-29 |website=Nayatel |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Internet ===
[[Fiber to the x|Fiber-to-the-home]] (FTTH) Internet is offered to residential consumers with plans ranging from 40&nbsp;Mbit/s to 500&nbsp;Mbit/s.

==== Network ====
In February 2020, Nayatel launched 10&nbsp;Gbit/s XG-PON for corporate customers<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 February 2023 |title=Nayatel Becomes First to Launch 10Gbps XG-PON in Pakistan |url=https://propakistani.pk/2020/02/19/nayatel-becomes-first-to-launch-10gbps-xg-pon-in-pakistan/ |access-date=29 August 2023 |website=ProPakistani}}</ref> and simultaneously began offering Fiber-to-the-Tower (FTTT) to [[Telenor Pakistan]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 February 2023 |title=Nayatel Connects 100+ Telenor Cell Sites on Fiber Optics |url=https://propakistani.pk/2020/02/18/nayatel-connects-100-telenor-cell-sites-on-fiber-optics/amp/ |access-date=29 August 2023 |website=ProPakistani}}</ref>

[[Facebook]] partnered with Nayatel in 2021 to expand their fiber network across eight cities.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Reporter |first=The Newspaper's Staff |date=2021-05-26 |title=Facebook partners with Nayatel for fibre network in Pakistan |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1625693 |access-date=2023-08-29 |website=DAWN.COM |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-05-27 |title=Pakistan: Facebook and Nayatel to offer internet access to 15 million citizens across 8 cities |url=https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/pakistan/pakistan-facebook-and-nayatel-to-offer-internet-access-to-15-million-citizens-across-8-cities-1.79504596 |access-date=2024-05-27 |website=gulfnews.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, Nayatel began rolling out IPv6 connectivity for both residential and corporate customers.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 February 2023 |title=Nayatel Rolls Out IPv6 |url=https://propakistani.pk/2023/02/25/nayatel-rolls-out-ipv6/ |access-date=29 August 2023 |website=ProPakistani}}</ref>

=== Television ===
[[Standard-definition television|Standard definition]] (SD) television channels are offered through basic cable<ref>{{Cite web |title=Basic Cable |url=https://nayatel.com/basic-cable/ |access-date=2023-08-29 |website=Nayatel |language=en-US}}</ref> and [[High-definition television|High-Definition]] (HD) television channels and a [[Video on demand|Video-on-Demand]] (VoD) platform are offered through a digital [[Set-top box|set-top-box]]<nowiki/>es branded 'Digital Box' and 'JoyBox'.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Joy Box |url=https://nayatel.com/joybox/ |access-date=2023-08-29 |website=Nayatel |language=en-US}}</ref> Their latest addition Android TV Box is a Google certified TV box that converts regular TV to smart TV.<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 8, 2024 |title=Nayatel Expands Its Home Entertainment Solutions with the Launch of Android TV Box |url=https://propakistani.pk/2024/01/08/nayatel-expands-its-home-entertainment-solutions-with-the-launch-of-android-tv-box/ |access-date=May 27, 2024 |website=Propakistani.pk}}</ref>

=== Surveillance systems ===
Nayatel started offering services of CCTV [[closed-circuit television]] digital surveillance to their clients by providing server based camera installation services with [[IP camera|ethernet]] connectivity.

==Nayatel Cloud==
In addition to being an ISP, Nayatel operates a [[cloud computing]] service known as 'Nayatel Cloud' to promote local hosting.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nayatel builds public cloud service with Charmed OpenStack |url=https://ubuntu.com/engage/nayatel-casestudy-charmed-openstack |access-date=2024-05-27 |website=Ubuntu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Nayatel deploys OpenStack Cloud |url=https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/131614-Nayatel-deploys-OpenStack-Cloud |access-date=2024-05-27 |website=www.thenews.com.pk |language=en}}</ref>

== Controversy ==

* Nayatel was one of the ISPs at odds with the [[Pakistan Telecommunication Authority]] (PTA) over the proposed changes to the DNS in Pakistan.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ali |first=Kalbe |date=2022-06-05 |title=PTA at odds with ISPs over domain policy |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1693213 |access-date=2024-08-26 |website=DAWN.COM |language=en}}</ref>

* Nayatel took the PTA to court over discrimination in Azad Kashmir.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Asad |first=Malik |date=2022-04-23 |title=Nayatel moves court against alleged discrimination by PTA |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1686297/nayatel-moves-court-against-alleged-discrimination-by-pta |access-date=2024-08-26 |website=DAWN.COM |language=en}}</ref>
* Competition Commission of Pakistan found in favour of Nayatel  against Peshawar Electric Supply Company (Pesco) in a Right of Way case.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Reporter |first=The Newspaper's Staff |date=2022-12-20 |title=Pesco ordered to reverse increase in Right of Way charges |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1727236 |access-date=2024-08-26 |website=DAWN.COM |language=en}}</ref>
* Nayatel submitted a complaint against PTCL with the PTA alleging blockage of traffic.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Gardezi |first=Ahsan |date=Feb 20, 2024 |title=PTA Asks Nayatel, PTCL, Zong and Telenor to Resolve Bandwidth Dispute Within 3 Days |url=https://propakistani.pk/2024/02/20/pta-asks-nayatel-ptcl-zong-and-telenor-to-resolve-bandwidth-dispute-within-3-days/ |access-date=2024-08-26 |work=ProPakistani}}</ref>
* Nayatel took up a case against the Army Heritage Foundation over Right of Way (ROW) charges.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Nasir |first=Jehangir |date=Jul 2, 2024 |title=Govt Stops Army Heritage Foundation From Charging Ridiculous ROW Fees From Nayatel |url=https://propakistani.pk/2024/07/02/govt-stops-army-heritage-foundation-from-charging-ridiculous-row-fees-from-nayatel/ |access-date=2024-08-26 |work=ProPakistani}}</ref>
